candidates.title: Update 6 Fixes v0.6.1.1
candidates.text:
- Fixed Nobelisk Gas clouds not disappearing on dedicated server
- Fixed long standing bug where picking up a Factory Cart holding an item could give you a portable miner instead of a Factory Cart
- Fixed Inventory is full prompt not showing up when trying to pick up statues
- Foundations should now snap better to roof pieces, snap underneath and be centered
- Foundations shouldn’t snap outside of the foundation they are being snapped to when snapping vertically anymore
- Fixed collision of the Tube Coral to avoid players from getting stuck on it
- Potential fix for a rare crash related to creatures
- Fixed a bug where dropping the Boombox around the HUB could cause it to be placed under it
- Fixed outlines not being shown properly on some decorative buildables
- Made some changes to the creature spawner to prevent creatures from spawning inside walls (as in, clipping in them)
- Fixed a bug where typing in the in-game chat would still result in keybinding actions (Like R reload, etc.)
- Fixed creatures getting stuck in shallow water

UI

- Fixed Ammo Counter and Icon not changing when reloading or switching ammo types
- Made the resolution change pop up size smaller
- Fixed typo in Arachnophobia option tooltip
- Overclocking now has a visible text box so you can enter percentages or numbers manually
- Split Stack slider now has a visible editable text box so you can enter the amount to split into manually
- Manufacturing buildings should now preview the overclocked per minute stat on each input and output before the new overclock is applied on the next cycle
- Fixed holstering the Boombox making the equipment HUD slot show incorrect info
- Polish on the Vehicle Path directional arrows in the Load Path Menu

DEDICATED SERVER

- Server should now error out instead of crash when the server is unable to bind to a query port
- Fixed a server crash when uploading a save file

LOCALISATION

candidates.title: WORLD OF HORROR review
candidates.text: A big "don't recommend" simply for how unenjoyable and bulls**t the "challenges" are. I would normally just ignore those things altogether, but of course the dev had to go and make them mandatory to unlock the secret playable character. Not to say they're all equally hard, or equally boring to play through, but enough are, and there's a lot of them. candidates.title: Important: About MODs and 1.0!
candidates.text:
[img src=" and Pocketpair support modding, and we're grateful to all our fans who have dedicated time into modding the game up now. We look forward to seeing all the amazing MODs that will be made after 1.0.

However, if you haven't played the game in a long time then it is possible you may have old and potentially harmful MOD data still on your PC.

The upcoming 1.0 update for Palworld makes significant changes to the game’s systems. If you still have MODs installed from the past, especially MODs that have been left installed since around 2024, you may encounter problems such as:

・Crashes when launching or playing the game

・Corrupted save data or save data failing to load

・Quests or events becoming impossible to progress

Please Note! Simply turning MODs “off” or “disabling” them is not enough.

MOD files and MOD loaders that remain in the game folder may still be loaded when the game starts, even if they have been disabled, and can cause issues. Please manually delete these files before updating. If you have ever installed MODs in the past, even if they are currently turned off, please make sure to delete the files.

Recommended steps before updating

(1) Back up your save data

(2) Manually delete old MOD files from the game folder. \[Most Important!]

If any of the following files or folders remain, please delete them or move them to another location. Simply disabling them with a MOD management tool will not delete them.

Please check these guidelines for instructions on how to remove mods: https://guideline.palworldgame.com/palworld-mod-guideline

(3) Verify the integrity of your game files on Steam

Steam Library → Right-click “Palworld” → “Properties” → “Installed Files” → “Verify integrity of game files”

(4) Confirm that the game launches correctly in an unmodded state before applying the update

Freedoms Greetings Helldivers, I'm your host Release Captain Carlberg bringing you democracy's latest and greatest from Super Earths superior minds. Its a lot of information so lets dive in!

Balancing

Goal with stratagem balance changes this patch:
With these balance changes we wanted to buff up some of the weaker stratagems to make them more viable and add more possibility for variety in the loadouts. We also changed a few to make them more consistent, but the goal was to keep a similar or higher power level.
We are looking into the stratagems more to see if there are any other stratagems that might need some buffs or changes to make them more viable. We also want to be better at explaining what our goals are with the changes, please see the linked blog post for more information.

A/MLS-4X Rocket Sentry

- Decreased spread
- Prioritize larger targets
- Increased target distance from 75 to 100m
- Decreased Rockets per salvo 2 to 1 (to get a better ammo economy)
- Increased explosion radius from 1m to 4m

candidates.title: PATCH 1.000.400 explained
candidates.text:
Helldivers!

Johan Pilestedt here, now in the Chief Creative Officer position at Arrowhead. First, I want to thank you, the community, for clearly voicing your opinions and concerns for the balance and fun of the game. With that, we have gone over a lot of the Weapon and Stratagem balance in our latest patch (01.000.400), and we wanted to share with you a little more information on the decisions we made.

With these balance changes we wanted to buff up some of the weaker stratagems to make them more viable and add more opportunity for variety in loadouts. We also changed a few to make them more consistent, but the goal was to keep a similar or higher power level.
We are looking into the stratagems more to see if there are any other stratagems that might need some buffs or changes to make them more viable. We also want to explain why we are making the changes we do, so that you can follow our thinking.

A/MLS-4X Rocket Sentry:
The old intent was to saturate an area with rockets, but it made it too inconsistent against medium and larger enemies.

We want to make it more consistent against medium and larger enemies and give it a better ammo economy to separate it from the autocannon sentry that has a higher damage output, but can waste ammo by shooting targets that are already dead.

A/MG-43 Machine gun sentry:
The Machine Gun Sentry felt like a worse version of the Gatling sentry and we wanted it to have a different place in the tool box.

We lowered the cooldown to make it more available and more useful when changing position often.

This patch marks the last set of changes we aimed to implement for the 60 day community commitment while also addressing issues we previously didn’t have time to fix.

So what does this patch contain?
We have made changes to the remaining weapons and stratagems we weren't able to finish for the patch on September 17th, ensuring they’re now more interesting and effective. We have also dedicated some time and we’ve looked over some key core systems like enemy spawning as well as targeting and vision for the Automatons. Based on your feedback, we’ve fine-tuned the Automaton experience to hopefully make them feel less frustrating to play against. Additionally, we have also adjusted the Helldivers durability to make your armor choices feel more impactful.

Finally, we've introduced new functionality to certain items to give players more depth in mastering their equipment. For example, the GR-8 Recoilless Rifle and the AC-8 Autocannon now have programmable ammunition, and drones that come with backpacks can be toggled on or off for added control.

We hope you enjoy these changes! The team at Arrowhead has been thrilled to work on this 60-day commitment for you, our community and players and seeing your reactions to the work we’ve done! candidates.text:
Dear Stormworkers,

This week we release a minor update entirely focused on bug fixes and quality improvements!

This update is the latest in a campaign of quality focused minor updates, and we have more planned for the future.

The main quality improvement is a change to how we save vehicle files - this change is backwards compatible so your existing vehicle files still work the same - but vehicles will now saved with a better compressed format, meaning their size on disk is now smaller. This has several benefits to players - some players with lower spec PCs are less likely to run out of memory if they don't have much RAM, saves are generally smaller, and vehicles should spawn faster in multiplayer.

In the patch notes below, you will see a lengthy list of all the changes we have made for this update. Some of the patch notes include an #issue number which relates to the issue id from the issue tracker. We are trying to provide this extra info so players can better see what has prompted the change, as well as look at the official issue tracker to better understand the discussion around the change.

This also clearly shows what is driving bug fixes and improvements to the game - the clear and concise issue reports that players submit - so thank you to every player who submitted an issue relating to the below. We are really pleased to have made these improvements to the game, and so thank you for your help.

This week we have been made aware of some networking issues caused by the new physics based fish system. While we were unable to patch this issue for today's update we are working on a fix that we hope to deliver by next week. In the meantime we recommend that server hosts disable wildlife in general settings to prevent network slowdown. Thank you for your patience and helping us out by reporting bugs to the issue-tracker site.

candidates.title: Dakar Desert Rally review
candidates.text: Dakar Desert Rally feels like a proper game release now.While it still doesn't run great, the huge stutters seem to be gone and driving the vehicles on a gamepad has greatly improved.I hope Saber keeps improving the game's optimization and, personally, I also hope they allow for even faster steering response in the next updates since it's still a bit on the slow side.On the topic of controls, the countersteering has improved on all vehicles, but it can still be a bit unreliable at points, likely due to it still being a touch slow.Otherwise the driving feels absolutely stellar. The grip makes sense, even if a bit high, the vehicles react well to jumps, you can feel the weight shift, and in general the bikes feel like bikes and the cars and trucks feel like cars and trucks.All in all, it's an amazing offroading experience with a huge playground to mess around in.The issues with wheel support have been fixed too, I can plug in my wheel and configure it without any trouble now.Some weird design choices are still there. When playing on the Sport mode that allows you to play the game like Sega Rally, when a vehicle gets ahead of you it's impossible to see due to the dust.If the point of the Sport mode is to make the game more accessible to a more casual audience, you should be able to see better when behind another vehicle in this mode, like in other arcade rally games.You can now start a quick race without going through the online lobby system, like any other game.Pick a vehicle, pick a location, and just have fun.They've also added the ability to pause the game midrace (because it's not online anymore) and it's possible to skip a part of the race start sequence.Sadly it's still an AI that launches your vehicle, you cannot rev it up yourself and launch it the way you want.

candidates.title: Unpacking review
candidates.text: This is NOT a negative review, I am merely saying I wouldn't recommend this game due to the price/hour played balance. I played for 2.7 hours, which Steam lowers to 2 hours. I'm gonna say I played for 3 hours. If I were to have 1 hour = 1 euro, I'd have to play another 17 hours to at least be even money-wise. I didn't speedrun this either, I just am a quick organizer.A great fun game that's surprisingly relaxing and manages to put in a story through the environment and the items the player unpacks. It's really cute with the artstyle, and the different types of accommodations the player goes through as we go through the character's life is a fun gimmick to keep things fresh. Seeing recurring items especially feels quite realistic, we all have our items we take with us through our life. The problem is that this game's only reason for replaying would be to acquire all the achievements. Personally I don't feel like unpacking everything again or putting things differently to enjoy the game again - I've experienced the (brilliantly executed) story already and enjoyed seeing the items and what they may mean for our character. I loved this game, but the price definitely felt a bit too steep for how short it truly is. Great concept though, nothing put praise for it!

candidates.text: Cleverly narrated without a narrator.Going into this game, I had no knowledge of the details other than it was a game about unpacking. When I started, I wondered, "This is cute, but is this it? Just unpacking boxes?"Yes, and no. This is a game about unpacking boxes. It is a meditative, relaxing experience that you can put as much or as little organization and thought into as you want. Brilliantly, the developers weave together a subtle narrative of a person's life based on where they live, what they bring with them, and what they leave behind.I played through the whole game in one sitting because I was genuinely enjoying myself too much to quit. I wholeheartedly recommend this as a sweet, wholesome experience that can more or less be what you'd like it to be.

candidates.title: Unpacking review
candidates.text: Unpacking is a lovely and whimsical game, which if you are someone who loves to organize, or someone who is procrastinating before an exam (me included) would definitely enjoy, although sometimes I wonder why the MC has so many things I don't think she needs, it makes me want to Marie Kondo her but that is off topic. The game is amazing in terms of story telling with many Easter Eggs and subtle story telling details (such as keeping on of the photos hidden in her closet after her break up) that would make any story teller weep in awe.That being said, for the price point it would have been much preferable to have more content than what is provided at the moment. I bought the game while it is on sale for around RM 30 (approx $6.73) and finished the game with all the achievements in less than 4 hours. The game is similar throughout the entire game play and most of the time (for me at least) was spent trying to find places to place MC's books, in other words this might as well be book organizing simulator. Hopefully there would be more content in the future but it does seem rather unlikely. I would not recommend this game unless it is on sale.
